chunks: If, by the will of Allah, the defeat occurs

then do not kill the runner away, do not strike a helpless person, do not finish off the wounded, and do not inflict pain on women even though they may attack your honour with filthy words and abuse your officers, because they are weak in character, mind and intelligence,
We have been ordered to desist from them although they may be unbelievers.
Even in pre-Islamic period if a man struck a woman with a stone or a stick he was rebuked along with his posteriors after him.

key_terms.مُعْوِرًا: the helpless or one whose eye is struck

ai.seo_question: What are the rules of engagement and treatment of women in Islamic warfare according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) articulates the *Sunnah* of warfare by prohibiting the pursuit of fleeing enemies (*al-mudbir*) and the killing of the wounded, establishing a precedent for proportional and humane conduct in battle. He specifically exempts women from combat despite their insults, citing their relative weakness in strength and intellect, while contrasting this with pre-Islamic practices where women were treated as property, thereby elevating their status through ethical restraint rather than mere utility.
